dana-lane.position: APEX of the triangle — mid-ground centre, head highest in frame, standing tall behind and above the slumped Supraman with one hand resting on his shoulder

pose.left_arm: hanging loose at her side, forearm thick and heavy
pose.right_arm: reaching down and forward to rest her open hand on Supraman's near shoulder
pose.hands: exactly two hands, both her own — right palm on his shoulder, left open at her side

dana-lane.expression: warm confident smile, eyes bright and steady, chin slightly raised — affectionate ownership of the moment, not cruelty

supraman.position: immediate FOREGROUND, lowest point of the triangle, slumped and seated, nearest the lens and therefore large but BELOW her head height

pose.overall: slumped and drained, shoulders rounded forward, spine curved, one knee up
pose.left_arm: draped over the raised knee, hand limp
pose.right_arm: propping him upright, palm flat on the floor
pose.hands: exactly two hands, both his own — one limp over the knee, one flat on the floor

supraman.expression: exhausted and dazed, mouth slightly open, brows raised — spent disbelief

dee-dee.position: BACK-RIGHT base point of the triangle, deepest of the three, smaller by perspective, pressing the graviton barbell overhead

pose.left_arm: raised overhead gripping the bar left of centre
pose.right_arm: raised overhead gripping the bar right of centre
pose.hands: exactly two hands, both her own, both wrapped around the barbell

dee-dee.expression: fierce triumphant grin, teeth showing, eyes narrowed with effort and delight

spatial_rules: exactly three people in the image: Supraman foreground-low, Dana mid apex, Dee-Dee back-right
exactly six hands total: Dana's two, Supraman's two, Dee-Dee's two on the bar
the three heads form a clear triangle — Dana's highest and forward, Supraman's lowest and nearest, Dee-Dee's set deep and to the right; no two figures at the same scale or depth
Dana reads as dominant through apex placement and Supraman being slumped, NOT by being drawn oversized on his plane; her real height is ordinary and she is NOT a giantess
all garment coverage intact — Supraman's suit is torn but covering
lighting: warm gym key from the upper left carving the triangle, Dana catching the brightest light at the apex, Supraman falling into shadow in the near foreground, Dee-Dee dimmer and cooler at depth
